senses.gloss: khikkhira, nt., presumably staff (cf. next and Deśīn. 〔2.73〕 khikkhirī = ḍumbādīnāṃ sparśaparihārārthaṃ cihnayaṣṭiḥ): Divy 〔570.7〕 Rudrāyaṇasya pātracīvaraṃ khikkhiraṃ (mss. corrupt, pointing rather to khikkhirikaṃ, see next) cādāya …; 〔16〕 idaṃ pātracīvaraṃ khikkhiraṃ ceti.
khikkhirika, see prec.; khikkhilikā, ˚līkā, with various corrupt vv.ll., = prec.: Svay 〔101.8〕; 〔210.1〕; 〔219.11〕.
